name: Gothdou no Otome-tachi
source:
It has been a week since the case of gothic loli rape case. Multiple loli have been assaulted at home and outdoors by either criminals or imitators.
Main character is a former basketball player with mediocre wits. He can't solve this case on his own, so he asks Erica, gothic girl with scissors, for help.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
